Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
Okay, so I know there is a ruling pending that may shed light on this:
www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/79982-powerbase-tshwane-when-to-lock

..that said, if it turns out that The Shard can be locked to reduce the cost of an action
after blocks are declined, I will still want to know the answer to this question:

If you do not control the Edge when you announce an action taken by Sargon, can you lock the Shard to reduce the cost of that action as it becomes successful and you get the Edge from Sargon's special text?

Thanks much! Card text copied below.
-Bill / Killiam

Name: The Shard, London
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique location.
If you have the Edge, you can lock this card to reduce the cost of a card you play by 2 pool or blood. Vampires can steal this location as a D action; Ventrue get +1 stealth during that action.

Name: Sargon
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Baali
Group: 2
Capacity: 5
Discipline: cel dai obf pre
Independent: Whenever Sargon successfully performs an action, you get the Edge. +1 strength. Infernal.

-Killiam
(Bill Troxel)  "I look back from where I'm from
Look at the woman I've become
And the strangest things seem
Suddenly routine"
-Hedwig Robinson

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Killiam wrote:
> If you do not control the Edge when you announce an action taken by Sargon, can you lock the Shard to reduce the cost of that action as it becomes successful and you get the Edge from Sargon's special text?
>
No, Sargon gives you the Edge after resolution.
